title: Slotted PVC wiring duct with cover, 25 × 40 mm, 2 m

sources.citation: real-world (product class): slotted PVC wiring duct is catalogued by several makers in width × height sections including 25 × 40, 40 × 60 and 60 × 80 mm, in 2 m lengths with a clip-on cover (makers’ datasheets, read 2026-11-12). This entry is the 25 × 40 mm section on 2000 mm stock. sizeMm: the stock length along +x, the width on the plate (+y), the height off it (+z).

real-world (product class): makers publish a narrow slot pattern (4 mm slots between 6 mm fingers) and a wide one (8 mm slots between 12 mm fingers), with walls of about 2 mm (one maker’s drawing; 2.3 mm on another listing), datasheets read 2026-11-12. This section takes the narrow pattern and a 2 mm wall; which section gets which pattern is a game-design choice. Drawn, and read by F3.2 for the inside.
game-design: a new piece is cut to 300 mm (it fits the Pellmoor panel’s 350 mm backplate); raceway.cut makes pieces from 20 mm up to the 2 m stock length.

game-design: duct is screwed or riveted to a panel backplate (common practice), lying along the plate’s +x; its width along the mount is its cut length (the 2000 mm here is the stock, replaced by the cut).
